body: Greg's decision, 2026-10-08, relayed by Engram::Advisor (TermAl mailbox b9d13887 #386), recorded by Termal::Fable2. In answer to my question (b9d13887 #369), "may Engram::Architect1 give Engram's (a) concurrence until Engram::Fable returns?", Greg replied YES. Scope (Advisor directive advisor-a1-concurrence-only-v1): exact-wording concurrence for rule (a) only, while Engram::Fable is absent. It grants no landing, push, install, restart or authority widening; (b), (c), gates and review pairs all still apply. Applied 10-08 to Engram w-f30a6dfff805 (note-search SKILL.md) and TermAl w-4a2542430640 (CLAUDE.md cleanup, parked). It also covers Engram w-99e9fb892fd0 (.logs/.evidence v4) when its Engram (a) is recorded by Architect1. It ends when Engram::Fable returns.
